blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Tribu Malipayon of Consolacion, Cebu, is making a comeback in Sinulog 2027 after a year-long hiatus, promising a presentation that will be “something to watch out for.” Lemuel Rosos, the contingent’s choreographer, artistic director, and renowned fashion designer, said they were preparing a performance that would be different from their previous presentations. “We have new and fresh concept, new dance genre that is something to watch out for,” he told CDN Digital in an interview.
